answer.label: quantization
answer.justification: Only activation measurements were available, and every one of them fits quantization. The layer-wise difference profile 0.096/0.184/0.194/0.205/0.255 matches the documented 0.101/0.190/0.197/0.205/0.251. The mid-layer size ratio is 0.968, a shrinking of the internal state that only quantization shows. Effective rank is 4.09 (high, noise-like), direction consistency is 0.514 (the lowest of any class), final cosine is 0.966, the final-layer jump is small (+0.027) and onset is at layer 11. The fine-tune classes are ruled out because their size ratio is above 1 (about 1.02), their direction consistency is higher (0.62–0.70), and they show either an onset at layer 3 or a +0.10 final-layer jump. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the small layer-2 spike (0.1, against about 42) and the layer-16 value of 0.19 instead of about 0.4.
